adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the adapter refreshes tokens via a direct `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` inside `getConn()`/client construction and does not use the new `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` helper that other adapters were switched to. That means when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` and `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` are set, Salesforce will still hit Salesforce directly rather than the parent app sync endpoint. Additionally, it runs the result through `parseRefreshTokenResponse(accessTokenJson, salesforceTokenSchema)`, and that helper will choose the “minimum token” schema in sync mode, which (given Zod’s object behavior) would not preserve extra Salesforce fields like `instance_url`/`id`/`signature` when persisting `key` via `prisma.credential.update(...)`, causing drift/data loss in saved credentials under sync mode.
